text:
maria.chen: Heads-up — canary shows a regression after last night's merge. p95 decode on shortseq small-batch traffic is ~+18% vs baseline (rolling canary 0.2 -> 0.4). Noticed after PR #4821 (fused-attn + prefetch heuristics).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for inference-runtime paused: metric_deviation(p95_decode)=18% > threshold. See: https://deploys.internal/redwood/canaries/1748654321

kai: Do we have a profiler/flamegraph? can you capture a canary sample with cpu/gpu traces and the KV hit/miss counters? e.g. ./ci/tools/profiler --target=canary --duration=60 --tags=kv,attn

maria.chen: Pasted a short flame excerpt:
```
0. kv_cache_lookup  34% (misses increased)
1. attn_fused_dispatch 22%
2. decode_step 18%
3. cuda_memcpy_async 12% (more churn)
```
Also KV miss-rate jumped from 2.1% -> 6.8% on canary. Prefetch counters show more evictions during warmup.

sara: Which commit touched batching/prefetch heuristics? I remember we adjusted shortseq batch thresholds in the same PR. Could be interaction between fused-attn kernel selection and prefetch timing.

lee: Quick plan: bisect between commit 8b7f2 (pre-merge) and HEAD of PR #4821. If bisect narrows to the prefetch heuristic change, revert that first since it's lower-risk. If it's the fused-attn dispatch, we'll need a hotpatch to kernel selector.

maria.chen: Repro on local perf runner: `./tools/repro --model=rwd-13b --seq=32 --batch=4 --prefix=1024 --iters=200`
Baseline p95: 48ms -> canary p95: 57ms. Reproducer logs attached (summarized): KV_lookup latency up x2, more memcpy stalls during attn.

kai: Ran `ci/tools/profiler` against the repro and dug into traces — looks like the fused-attn path causes extra temporary buffer allocations when prefetch fires during microbatch boundaries. Patch #4821 changed the prefetch timing from ON_WARMUP -> ON_APPEND which increases overlap with fused-kernel warm paths.

ana: (ops) CI note: the perf gate did not catch this because our perf suite lacks a shortseq small-batch microbench that runs the exact warmup pattern. I'll add one to ci/perf/shortseq_microbench.

sara: I'm opening a rollback PR that reverts the prefetch heuristic change and adds a tuned delay. Will mark as hotfix and request an expedited review. cc @kai @maria.chen :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Hotfix PR #4892 merged to main and rolling to canary (0.4 -> 0.6).

maria.chen: Monitoring — after the hotfix roll started p95 dropped back to 49ms in the first sample. KV miss-rate back to ~2.3%. Will watch for 30m before resuming.

lee: Follow-up: opening issue to add shortseq microbench to CI, add a canary gate that looks at kv_miss_rate and attn_kernel_switch_rate, and add a test matrix for ON_WARMUP vs ON_APPEND prefetch modes. Link: https://issues.internal/redwood/INF-1123

kai: Postmortem note: the interaction surface between kernel selection (fused vs generic) and prefetch heuristics needs explicit contracts. We'll add invariant tests and a simple unit test that asserts no extra allocations/syncs during warmup when fused-attn is selected.

maria.chen: Thanks everyone — hotfix looks good so far. I'll follow up with a short writeup + perf graphs in the eng-runtime perf dash. :coffee:
